soon.title: The brain is going 3D.
soon.body: You're on a secret test drive. Buckle up — the brakes are still with engineering.
soon.hookLead: Be first when the doors open:
soon.hookRest: one tap puts you on the list; launch day you get a single ping. No spam — promise.

noro.placeholder: Write to NÖRO… (e.g. how does my cerebellum grow?)
noro.note: Don't write operational info, location, unit, or personal names. NÖRO is an AI assistant and can make mistakes.
noro.teamOnly: During maintenance only the team can get in. Your account is fine; when the doors open, you'll be among the first to know.

nogl.title: 3D brain couldn't open on this device.
nogl.body: Your browser doesn't support 3D drawing or it's disabled. NÖRO and everything else still work — ask NÖRO about a region by name.
